headline: Howard's 10th-inning double walks off Rockies
recap: Chase Utley led off the bottom of the 10th inning with a single off Taylor Buchholz. After Pat Burrell struck out, Ryan Howard doubled to left field to send Utley around from first with the winning run, giving the Phillies a 6-5 win over the Colorado Rockies.
Kyle Lohse started for Philadelphia and allowed three runs over six innings. Colorado countered with Ubaldo Jimenez, who also went six innings and allowed two runs.

The Phillies trailed 5-2 in the seventh after Matt Holliday's two-run homer put Colorado ahead, but Pat Burrell answered in the bottom half with a three-run homer that scored Jimmy Rollins and Utley to tie the game at 5-5. Brett Myers pitched the ninth and 10th innings in relief to earn the win, and Taylor Buchholz took the loss after allowing the go-ahead run in the 10th.
